projects.title: My Projects
projects.subtitle: Portfolio
projects.beautyagenda_desc: Appointment scheduling and WhatsApp automation system for a beauty salon. REST API with Spring Boot, PostgreSQL and Spring Security, deployed in the cloud and in real-world use.
projects.marias_beauty_desc: Showcase website for a beauty salon built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS with WhatsApp integration and interactive maps.
projects.jfocus_desc: Desktop task management application built with JavaFX.
projects.nanosip_desc: Enterprise management system with role-based access control. Handles employees, clients, sales, inventory and suppliers. REST API with Spring Boot and database deployed on Azure.
projects.nanosip_api_desc: REST API built with Spring Boot for the Nanosip project.
projects.atmos_desc: Android mobile app that consumes a weather API to display real-time weather conditions.
projects.retail_backend_desc: REST API that turns each store's sales, inventory and staff data into actionable recommendations: a custom demand forecasting engine (Ayax), profit-maximizing promotions, smart inventory and staff allocation. Multi-store with 3 PostgreSQL databases and optional AI (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini) with automatic fallback. My main contribution.
projects.retail_frontend_desc: "Mi sucursal" PWA that consumes the API: dashboards for sales, inventory, promotions, demand and staff, plus Softy, an assistant that generates interfaces from text or voice using an LLM. Built by the team; I handled its integration with the backend and deployment.
